protocol.name: R2 independent Qwen six-dimension evaluation v1
protocol.rubric: R1 six-dimension rubric, raw sum 0..10; not equal-normalized training reward
protocol.initial_frame: last observed frame, index1 of two input observations
protocol.input: instruction + 1 initial observation + 8 uniformly sampled generated frames; no reference future, model name or reward score
protocol.image_conversion: float predictions clipped[0,1], multiplied255, rounded, uint8; native RGB resolution, processor defaults
protocol.seed: 20261014 + dataset_index*10000 + trajectory_index; same seed across arms
protocol.retry: Only invalid/truncated output gets one retry with seed+1000000, identical budget. First valid result retained; all attempts preserved. Never retry based on score.
protocol.aggregation: per-dataset, per-arm means and sample SD over trajectories; total computed from six raw scores; paired trajectory bootstrap CI, single model-training seed
protocol.invalid_policy: Missing scores never imputed as zero; explicit failure counts; paired statistics only on common valid IDs; not complete128 unless all128 valid
protocol.pilot: indices0,64 for all4arms x3datasets, plus recorded/static controls for index0 in each dataset; schema pass >=90%, no outcome/ranking gate
protocol.scope: Existing R2 variants, not original R1 generator. Does not establish comparability to historical RobotWorldBench Table1 or accuracy of the automatic judge.

cohort.repair: First two attempts reproduce original4096token/180s protocol; only invalid records get one extra8192token/360s attempt at originalseed+2000000. First valid retained. Primary and repaired aggregates both retained. No score-based retries.
